article.title: Sky News擴大Arc XP合作，新網站與App目標2027年底推出
article.title_en: Sky News expands Arc XP partnership for app and website targeted for end-2027
article.summary: Sky於11月2日公布平台合作，將影片及個人化放在新體驗中心。
article.summary_en: Sky announced a platform agreement focused on video and personalization on November 2.
highlights: 新網站與App仍在規劃，目標2027年底推出。
合作延續現有Ask Sky News對話式搜尋。
highlights_en: The new app and website are targeted for launch by end-2027.
The agreement builds on existing Ask Sky News conversational search.
article.why: 內容品牌可思考，如何把AI搜尋帶來的接觸轉成讀者直接回訪。
article.why_en: Content brands can examine how AI discovery might lead to direct audience relationships.
article.next_step: 先盤點自有網站的影片入口、訂閱路徑與讀者回訪指標。
article.next_step_en: Review video entry points, subscription journeys and return-visit measures.
article.detail: Arc XP將提供以AWS支援的媒體平台，包括手機應用、影片與個人化工具，配合Sky News 2030轉型。公告把新平台定位為建立直接讀者關係及探索付費產品的途徑，這些屬業務目標，尚非已實現成果。Ask Sky News是既有合作項目，不能把它寫成此次才推出；新網站與App亦未上線。本報未測試其搜尋質素或個人化成效。
article.detail_en: Arc XP will provide AWS-backed mobile, video and personalization tools for Sky News 2030. Direct audience growth and paid products are objectives, not established results. Ask Sky News already exists; the new app and website have not launched.
